integrity: Proof is analytic for arbitrary radii and trim levels. Exact arithmetic and finite stress checks corroborate but do not replace the proof. First-public day refers to a dated supporting publication rather than an asserted date of invention.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite paths with clamped endpoint extension, odd centered windows and equal trimming at both tails.
No claim about exact constants below the stated path-length cutoff or under cyclic/nonuniform boundary conventions.
Early related 1984 material was not fully accessible; historical priority has residual uncertainty.
title: Sharp two-input bounded-variation stability for every symmetric sliding trimmed mean
